Class TechSupportSpecialist

java.lang.Object
project.models.actors.User
project.models.actors.Employee
project.models.actors.TechSupportSpecialist
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, JournalObserver
public class TechSupportSpecialist extends Employee
Tech-support specialist responsible for handling employee requests. Typical lifecycle for a request: VIEWED (on open) → ACCEPTED or REJECTED → DONE.
